name: Tan Dinh Church
kicker: The pink church on Hai Bà Trưng
summary: Pink church at 289 Hai Bà Trưng: stop for the rose facade on the way through Tân Định. Built in 1876, the walls are pink with white and blue ornament, Gothic with Roman and a little Baroque. The altars inside are precious stone brought from Italy. Chợ Tân Định, the market, is another stop on the same road.

heroCaption: The pink facade and the rose window, from the street
body: Nhà thờ Tân Định, also Nhà thờ Thánh Tâm Chúa Giêsu, is at 289 Hai Bà Trưng, Phường Tân Định. It was built in 1876, Gothic with Roman and a little Baroque, pink walls with white and blue ornament. The altars inside are precious stone brought from Italy. Ask at the door about the hour.

The photograph is the pink front from the street, spire and rose window. The second frame is the nave, looking toward the altar. Chợ Tân Định is the market on Hai Bà Trưng. The church is the building. The market is the food stop.
